osfBehavior.basis: No License is unavailable for OSF Registries, and a user without a project license is prompted to select one when submitting.

prospectiveCandidate.name: Apache License 2.0
prospectiveCandidate.rationale: All 57 archived artifacts are tracked source-form code, documentation, or verification records from the Apache-2.0 repository. Selecting Apache-2.0 would align the external record with that existing repository license rather than silently inheriting registration 63sh5's CC0 selection.
prospectiveCandidate.requiredBeforeActivation: confirmation by the relevant copyright holder or authorized legal decision-maker that one Apache-2.0 selection validly covers the combined archive

cc0Inheritance.reason: The original registration's CC0 selection is not evidence that the later code-and-documentation archive may be relicensed under CC0.

blockingQuestions: exact bytes and filename of every stored license artifact
whether every license artifact exists and can be redownloaded during private draft staging
whether any different license representation is introduced only by submission
authorized confirmation that Apache-2.0 covers the combined external record
failClosedRule: If any provider-visible license artifact first appears during submission or its exact bytes cannot be frozen before submission, the mechanism remains NO-GO.
